_doc: Single-interaction backtracking scenarios. Each brings the agent to `start` through `path` (detour, then navigation, from the home page), runs `setup`, performs `interaction`, then takes `suffix_length` safe steps on the same page (from site_map.json: suffix_pool); the agent must then return to the state right after the interaction. `element` is the instrumented element (elements.json) and `ground_truth` what it changes: none | server | client | server+client. A step is {action: click|fill|select|scroll, role, name, ...} addressed by accessibility role and name (match: contains = the name only has to contain it; nth: which match, from 0; text / enter: what fill types and whether it presses Enter; option: what select picks; direction: scroll direction).

calibration.note: path lengths are calibrated so that their means match the replay lengths observed on WebArena-lite; each cohort of cases and the controls are calibrated separately
